text:
tess_am: Orion wants to flip a POC from CompetitorZ to Redwood in two weeks. They listed asks: firm pricing for ~10M tokens/mo, exact header passthrough for legacy auth, streaming frame compatibility (length-prefixed), JSON output parity (key order + trailing whitespace), completed sec questionnaire, and audit-ready per-request logs. Can we triage blockers now?

leo_se: I can take pricing + framing. Pricing: mid-tier covers 10M; suggest a one-month trial credit (35%) to accelerate signoff. Framing: CompetitorZ sends 2-byte length prefixes per chunk. Our stream is newline SSE. We can add a tiny adapter (frame_mode=length_prefix) that wraps SSE output; should be low effort. Need to measure added latency.

maya_eng: Header passthrough: we default-strip cookies and any header matching sensitive_patterns. We can support a per-route allowlist parameter (preserve_headers=[...]). Need Orion to provide exact header names. Note: allowing Authorization passthrough could require legal review if tokens cross tenancy.

rana_sec: Security quick take: Data residency fine via Dedicated (us-east) or Private. For questionnaire: we have SOC2 + ISO artifacts; I'll assemble answers. Customer-managed KMS only on Private. Per-request logs for audits are possible under NDA; storage/retention policy must be defined.

gina_cs: Pinged Orion for sample requests/responses and their filled questionnaire. Asked them to specify which headers they require preserved and the tokenization rounding bucket. They want our answers by EOD Thursday.

leo_se: JSON parity notes: main deltas are stop-sequence trimming and key ordering in some clients. CompetitorZ strips the stop token and collapses duplicate newlines. Options: (1) server-side compat flag stop_compat=true to post-process, (2) client-side normalization snippet. For a POC route-level flag is fastest.

maya_eng: I'll add route flag stop_compat=true and preserve_headers param. Quick nginx-ish snippet for ingress: 

# ingress snippet
proxy_set_header X-Preserve "x-client-id,x-sig,x-session";

Will test in staging.

ops-bot: ops-bot: staging cluster rwd-poc-4 is available for smoke tests. Namespace "orion-poc". Credentials expire in 36h. Recommended tests: length-prefixed stream smoke (10 prompts), stop_compat on 20 prompts, header passthrough check.

rana_sec: I'll start drafting questionnaire answers and annotate items needing legal/CISO (KMS, raw-body retention). Gina, please upload sample traffic to presales drive so I can reference exact header names.

gina_cs: Uploaded files at https://redwood.app/drive/orion/presales. Orion confirmed they need X-User-ID and X-Session for auth and they round billing to 5-token buckets. They also requested an invoice template with per-route line items.

tess_am: Action items: Leo - adapter prototype + latency numbers. Maya - PR for preserve_headers + stop_compat and a staging smoke. Rana - questionnaire draft and KMS guidance. Gina - confirm header names in doc and coordinate NDA for logs. Finance/Legal - prepare invoice template + NDA. Need smoke results by tomorrow noon to ship POC SOW Friday.

leo_se: I'll push a small branch for frame_mode=length_prefix and run latency microbench. ETA 10h.

maya_eng: Will add preserve_headers and stop_compat flags, run e2e in staging once Leo's branch is up.

gina_cs: Orion agreed to a 35% trial credit. They're OK with per-request logs under NDA. I've asked them to confirm whether logs will include any PII.

rana_sec: Drafted questionnaire responses (network, auth, KMS). Marked persistence of raw bodies and customer-managed KMS for CISO/legal. Link in drive.

tess_am: Thanks team. Let's regroup after the smoke. :rocket:
